rows.outcome: Narration clips reach Keboola Files, and audio_file_id on the emitted event is a real Files id (or empty on a terminal failure, never the archive artifact id that used to be projected there). The event is held durably until its clip's upload resolves, one way or the other, so a crash, a relaunch, or a missing/expired credential delays the row instead of losing the clip or emitting a wrong value.
rows.automatedEvidence: NarrationSpoolTests, NarrationDeliveryWorkerTests, NarrationUploadRetryPolicyTests, NarrationDeliveryPresentationTests, NarrationDeliverySettingsTests, KeboolaFilesClientTests (kind-aware media-type gate), CaptureEngineTests (narration custody/withholding)

rows.outcome: A managed policy or installer preference, read from the registry, overrides the user's own capture-at-launch setting and renders as enforced rather than an ordinary toggle; a value that cannot be parsed is a visible misconfiguration, never a silent fallback to the permissive option. Both slices of #60: the client's read-only policy layer (slice 1), and the per-user MSI's JAZZ_CAPTURE_AT_LAUNCH property, which writes the installer-preference key on every install -- 0 (no opinion) by default, or 1 on a clean profile when the property is set. The MSI does not validate the property value, and AppSearch makes it a first-install deployment input only: once a value already exists, a later msiexec invocation with a different property value does not change it (see docs/INTUNE_DEPLOYMENT.md).
rows.automatedEvidence: CaptureAtLaunchPolicyTests, CaptureAtLaunchPolicyStoreTests, EffectiveCaptureAtLaunchTests (precedence ladder and malformed-value theories), OnboardingWindowContentTests (PolicyUnreadable copy), SettingsWindowPauseTests (ResolveSavedCaptureAtLaunch), Verify-Msi.ps1 and verify-msi.sh (AppSearch/RegLocator/Registry/CustomAction/LaunchCondition/FeatureComponents assertions), Invoke-MsiLifecycleQualification.ps1 (installed-policy-default, installed-policy-kind, repair-policy-preserved, uninstall-policy-removed, registry sentinel), Invoke-UpgradeTestMatrixQualification.ps1 (install-n-policy-enforced, upgrade-policy-preserved, upgrade-policy-update-observed, changed-same-version-policy, final-policy-removed), Invoke-ReleaseUpgradeQualification.ps1 (candidate-policy-preserved, candidate-policy-removed)
rows.manualEvidence: Managed policy on (immediate recording, no tray interaction); a malformed managed value forcing startup off while a user setting and launch switch are both on, with the visible misconfiguration notice rather than an organisational-decision claim (idle, disabled checkbox); policy removal (the user's own prior preference is honoured again, unwritten by any enforced state); pause still beats an enforced-on policy; a silent unelevated MSI install with JAZZ_CAPTURE_AT_LAUNCH=1 on a clean standard-user profile enforcing capture with no tray interaction; the Intune package installing, being detected, and uninstalling on a clean standard-user profile
